mapper.sql: c.`id` AS id, c.`user_id` AS userId, c.`blog_id` AS blogId, c.`parent_id` AS parentId, c.`answer_id` AS answerId, c.`content` AS content, c.`liked` AS liked, c.`create_time` AS createTime, u.`nick_name` AS nickName, u.`icon` AS icon
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM tb_blog_comments c LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.blog_id = #{blogId} AND c.parent_id = 0 AND (c.status IS NULL OR c.status = 0) ORDER BY c.id DESC
